sub_obligations.name: Distinction Preservation
sub_obligations.formal_reading: For all topological states A, B in Dom(Pi_geo): if A and B are topologically distinct, then their geometric images under Pi_geo must remain distinct.
sub_obligations.explicit_definition: Distinction preservation holds iff distinct topology-origin distinction classes remain distinct after projection and recover through tau_geo.
sub_obligations.check_mechanism: Compare Trace_geo(T).distinction_class against tau_geo(Pi_geo(T)).distinction_class for all T in Dom(Pi_geo). Any case where distinct source classes map to the same image class is a failure event.
sub_obligations.failure_consequence: Pi_geo is a lossy compression, not a legal projection. Geometry_app would alias distinct topological states and cannot be admitted.
sub_obligations.equivalence_constraint: ~_geo must not collapse non-equivalent Topology_app distinction classes; see geo_projection_legality_definitions.json equivalence_relation_declaration

sub_obligations.name: Admissibility Preservation
sub_obligations.formal_reading: If a topological state T is admissible, then its geometric image Pi_geo(T) must also be admissible.
sub_obligations.explicit_definition: Admissibility preservation holds iff every projected Geometry_app object retains PASS admissibility status under inherited topology-origin labels.
sub_obligations.check_mechanism: For all T in Dom(Pi_geo) where Trace_geo(T).admissibility_status == PASS: confirm tau_geo(Pi_geo(T)).admissibility_status == PASS. A PASS-to-FAIL transition is a failure event. Note: T with admissibility_status == FAIL is outside Dom(Pi_geo) by admission_rule.
sub_obligations.failure_consequence: Pi_geo would generate inadmissible states from admissible inputs, breaking the admissibility invariant. geometry_app would not be a lawful continuation.

sub_obligations.name: Orientation Trace Preservation
sub_obligations.claim: orientation class of T remains recoverable from Pi_geo(T)
sub_obligations.formal_reading: For any T in Dom(Pi_geo), the orientation class label declared in Trace_geo(T) must be recoverable from Pi_geo(T) via tau_geo.
sub_obligations.explicit_definition: Orientation trace preservation holds iff the orientation class declared before projection is recoverable after projection.
sub_obligations.check_mechanism: For all T in Dom(Pi_geo): compute tau_geo(Pi_geo(T)).orientation_class and compare against Trace_geo(T).orientation_class. Any mismatch, null, or undefined return from tau_geo is a failure event (TAU-UNDEF-2).
sub_obligations.failure_consequence: The orientation-conditioned selection routing through Topology_app becomes opaque after projection. OPEN_BRIDGE_001 structural routing becomes untraceable. The selector-routing role of OPEN_BRIDGE_001 is undermined.
sub_obligations.tau_geo_dependency: OBJ-GEO-TRACE-001 — undefined if orientation class is missing or conflicted (TAU-UNDEF-2, TAU-UNDEF-3)

sub_obligations.name: Closure Trace Preservation
sub_obligations.claim: closure identity of T remains traceable after Pi_geo(T)
sub_obligations.formal_reading: For any T in Dom(Pi_geo), the closure class declared in Trace_geo(T) must remain traceable in Pi_geo(T) via tau_geo. Distinct closures must not be aliased.
sub_obligations.explicit_definition: Closure trace preservation holds iff closure classes remain recoverable and non-aliased after projection.
sub_obligations.explicit_check: tau_geo(Pi_geo(T)).closure_class == Trace_geo(T).closure_class AND closure_class mapping is injective across compared T objects
sub_obligations.check_mechanism: Two-part check: (1) For all T in Dom(Pi_geo): tau_geo(Pi_geo(T)).closure_class must equal Trace_geo(T).closure_class. (2) For all T_A, T_B in Dom(Pi_geo) with distinct closure classes: tau_geo(Pi_geo(T_A)).closure_class must differ from tau_geo(Pi_geo(T_B)).closure_class. Failure of either part is a failure event (TAU-UNDEF-4 for aliasing).
sub_obligations.failure_consequence: Closure-stability arguments grounding Topology_app become untraceable in Geometry_app. Any downstream structural claim invoking closure support is disconnected from its basis.
sub_obligations.tau_geo_dependency: OBJ-GEO-TRACE-001 — undefined if closure class is missing, conflicted, or aliased (TAU-UNDEF-2, TAU-UNDEF-3, TAU-UNDEF-4)
